9b065f00a4.a: 26% of OpenAI's stock is in the OpenAI Foundation, which implies around $260 billion if they're valued at a trillion dollars. That dwarfs the size of the Gates Foundation endowment more than double.

6485b77608.q: What annual funding threshold does Ultra Philanthropy's mid-stage fund target for organizations seeking Series A grants?
6485b77608.a: Ultra Philanthropy typically enters when an organization already turns over $300,000 USD a year, though Lewers notes hearing that it can be very hard to get from $100,000 to $300,000, so they may lower that threshold. They aim to support organizations scaling from spending a few hundred thousand dollars per year to absorbing and deploying $10 million a year.

c6b98377e2.q: Why does Jack Lewers believe two large funders are better than one that is twice as large?
c6b98377e2.a: Lewers states that two coefficient givings beats one that is twice as big due to concentration risk. If only one or two organizations control funding decisions, organizations working in areas less appealing to those funders or that fall outside their thematic focus could have nowhere to turn for support.
